name: Seeed Studio XIAO ESP32-C3
description: Main compute; BLE + WiFi; USB-C accessible through enclosure wall
notes: Pin map per WIRING.md: SDA=GPIO6(D4) SCL=GPIO7(D5) SERVO_PWM=GPIO5(D3) LBO_IN=GPIO2(D0)

name: Adafruit DRV2605L
description: LRA motor driver; onboard 123-effect waveform library; RTP mode for custom waveforms
notes: I2C address confirmed via node_commissioning_protocol.md step 7

name: 10mm Coin LRA (class C10-100)
description: Rapid localised frequency-variable haptic; press-fit into enclosure floor
notes: Resonant frequency target ~175 Hz per commissioning protocol step 11

name: SG51R Micro Servo
description: Drives sliding mass on 30mm linear rail; slow directional spatial expression
notes: Sweep range 750-2250us per commissioning protocol step 12; center = 1500us

name: Adafruit PowerBoost 500C
description: Single power-management layer; boosts LiPo to 5.2V for servo + XIAO 5V pin; LBO pin gives digital low-battery signal to GPIO2
notes: Rev A architecture - replaces legacy 100k/100k analog divider (see WIRING.md)

name: JST-PH 2-pin
notes: CAUTION: verify polarity with multimeter before connecting - third-party LiPos frequently swap +/- vs Adafruit convention (WIRING.md critical warning)

name: 4.7k ohm resistor (pull-up)

name: Small prototyping perfboard (~20mm x 15mm)

name: 30mm linear rail

name: M5 brass sliding mass
